school.school_name: 専門学校中央情報大学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find the FY2026 target confirmation form on a school information page that lists multiple fiscal-year support PDFs.
search_queries: 専門学校中央情報大学校 令和8年度 修学支援制度 確認申請書
中央情報大学校 様式第2号 令和８年度
steps: Find the 情報公開 section listing 修学支援制度 confirmation forms by fiscal year.
Select the link labeled 令和８年度_修学支援制度における確認申請書（様式第2号）.
Accept it as FY2026 because the anchor explicitly says 令和８年度 and the PDF body contains 専門学校中央情報大学校 plus target-form 様式第２号 sections.

reusable_rules: When a disclosure page lists multiple 修学支援制度 confirmation-form PDFs by fiscal year, prefer the anchor whose label names the target fiscal year.
Keep the selected PDF URL as the exact expected evidence even when adjacent older-year forms remain on the same page.
Accept a WordPress-hosted support PDF when the anchor supplies current fiscal-year evidence and the PDF body has exact school-name plus target-form sections.
anti_patterns: Do not let older 令和７年度/令和６年度 confirmation forms outrank the current 令和８年度 form.
Do not infer current-year success for adjacent information-disclosure PDFs that inherit stale confirmation-form context.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found the multi-year support-form list, verified the 令和８年度 anchor, and verified the PDF body contains 専門学校中央情報大学校 plus target-form 様式第２号 sections.
